## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A four-fascicle (4卷) **profound-significance treatise** (*xuányì* 玄義) on the *Śūraṃgamasūtra* ([KR6j0118](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0118)) by **Yōuxī Chuándēng** 幽溪傳燈 [傳燈](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%82%B3%E7%87%88) (1554 – 1628). The genre name *xuányì* recalls Tiāntái Zhìyǐ's foundational *Miàofǎ liánhuá jīng xuányì* 妙法蓮華經玄義 (T1716) and signals Chuándēng's project: to produce for the *Lèngyánjīng* the **Tiāntái-style five-fold prefatory treatment** (*wǔzhòng xuányì* 五重玄義: *shìmíng* 釋名, *biàntǐ* 辨體, *míngzōng* 明宗, *lùnyòng* 論用, *pànjiào* 判教) that the sūtra had not previously received from the Tiāntái lineage. Preserved as **X13 no. 282** in the *Xùzàngjīng*.

**Abstract**

The work is the **Tiāntái-doctrinal prolegomena** to Chuándēng's larger *Lèngyán* commentarial project, the *Yuántōng shū* 圓通疏 ([KR6j0689](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0689)), and to the secondary *Yuántōng shū qiánmáo* 前茅 ([KR6j0705](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0705)). It applies the standard Tiāntái *wǔzhòng xuányì* framework to the *Lèngyánjīng*, classifying it as a sūtra of the *fāngděng* 方等 period in Tiāntái's *wǔshí pànjiào* 五時判教 ("five-period classification"), with affinities to the *Fǎhuá* "perfect teaching" (*yuánjiào* 圓教).

Together with [KR6j0689](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0689) and [KR6j0705](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0705), the *Xuányì* constitutes Chuándēng's three-part Tiāntái-doctrinal *Lèngyán* programme. The dating is precise: **1597 CE** for the Chuánrú preface, with the body of the *Xuányì* itself composed in or shortly before that year.
